selection_method: security consequence before style or maintainability
complete census for populations at or below twenty
deterministic application-and-structure clustered sample for larger populations
target forty to sixty blind cases based on Batch 01 reviewer load

rules.review_scope: two deterministic identities per application, access-mode and path-form cluster plus suppression census
rules.selection_reason: The upstream rule matches every open call but describes file-traversal risk, so path provenance and trust boundaries determine whether the claim is useful.
External process execution is a high-consequence review sink, but static argument lists and attacker-influenced command construction are materially different claims.
